# Expanded Old-App Scenario Disposition Ledger

## Scope and interpretation

The canonical parser `scripts/behaviour-coverage.mjs` uses `@cucumber/gherkin` Pickles. It expanded all 63 source feature files at revision `bafba8b77f634cca89a5967f142767b81d743248` into 487 identities, including 68 Examples rows; parsing and scenario-shape validation returned zero errors. Per-identity raw Pickle/steps/tags and exact source exemption comments are in ignored `local-tmp/plan/ayokoding-app-web/scenario-source-identities.jsonl`.

Each expanded row has one new-app destination or an explicitly retained old owner. Adapted scenarios receive native ExBdd Unit ownership, with Vitest only for listed browser state/focus/progress helpers. Integration applies at the Phoenix ConnCase/LiveView boundary except for browser-local progress/preferences records, whose alternative proof is the corresponding Vitest Unit scenario. E2E applicability is reconsidered against the new fixtures and routes; old exemption comments remain source provenance and are not transferred automatically. A row says `ADD-REQUIRED P2` when no exact scenario title exists in the ten-file new corpus. Retained contracts keep their old owner and existing layer decisions. All future tests are marked pending, not delivered.

Baseline disposition totals for the 487 identities at revision `bafba8b77f634cca89a5967f142767b81d743248`: {"adapt":464,"retained":21,"implementation-only":2}. The append-only v3 overlay below adds 10 retained Next.js-only identities, yielding the current reconciled total of 497: {"adapt":464,"retained":31,"implementation-only":2}.

## Reconciliation boundary

This is a Phase 0 destination and ownership ledger. Runtime verification remains pending and is performed under the delivery actions for each owning feature. Retained old-owner checks continue to run under their existing project targets; the Phoenix rewrite does not adopt or rewrite their framework-specific contracts. Implementation-only rows cite a replacement proof or explain why no product outcome is removed.

## Append-only source overlay: ayokoding-www build-worker controls

This supplement preserves the original 487 rows, their source revision, IDs, and dispositions above. The accepted v3 source packet adds ten Examples to the existing five-row build-worker outline in `specs/apps/ayokoding/www/behaviours/build-tools/build-workers/build-workers.feature`. Its six-subject manifest is in primary ignored `local-tmp/swe-reviewer/build-worker-override-v3/README.md`; the feature SHA-256 is `50b04d26649038b2287cad58ef4d023a545469abb37e855e76942b8377acb7ad`. The current feature contains 15 expanded identities: the five original identities remain rows 30–34 above; this section adds only the ten new identities.

Supplement IDs `BW-SUP-01` through `BW-SUP-10` are stable ledger IDs assigned by feature path, current Example line, and Example values. They are append-only source identities, not Cucumber Pickle ordinals; parser enumeration can change when the corpus changes. No Phoenix scenario is invented for these Next.js build-worker configuration controls. Each remains owned by `ayokoding-www` because it directly specifies that application's build configuration.

For all ten rows, the exact Unit owner is `ayokoding-www:test:unit` in `apps/ayokoding-www/tests/unit/build-workers.unit.test.ts`. The accepted v3 review attributes the matching v2 function and Unit adapter hashes and focused Unit session `60944` (45/45 passing, 1.10s); the v3 packet reports all four static behavior-binding validators passing for 63 feature files / 497 expanded scenarios. Integration and E2E are independently exempt for each row: this decision is pure in-process option selection, touches no local-resource or Phoenix boundary, and has no public browser/HTTP observation. The named Unit scenario in that row is its exact alternative proof for both exempt layers. These exemptions apply to this retained Next.js contract only.
